items.title: Arched Abstract Mosaic DXF Door Panel for CNC Routing
items.description: Free for laser and CNC use, this arch-topped panel packs together irregular abstract shapes, small crescents, and a central floral rosette into a dense mosaic composition. Unlike the more orderly mandala designs in this collection, the shapes here vary in size and orientation for a livelier, less predictable texture.

items.title: Angular Shard Burst DXF Pattern for Contemporary Panels
